title: WPMS/1043/2014 of Ram Roop Singh Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
CLMA No. 13899 of 2014
CLMA No. 13900 of 2014
CLMA No. 13901 of 2014
In
WPMS No. 1043 of 2004
Honíble Alok Singh, J.
 Mr. T.A. Khan, Senior Advocate
assisted by Mr. S.C. Tamta, Advocate for
the applicants.
 Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for the
private respondents.
 Sole landlord Sobha Ram has
expired on 16.9.2013, however, his
LRs/present applicants could not
approach this Court at the earliest to get
themselves substituted. Therefore, now
they have moved present applications
seeking substitution as well as seeking
condonation of delay in moving the
substitution application and the
application for setting aside abetment, if
any.
 Applying the principle that none
should be condemned without hearing,
and fair opportunity should be given to
the parties, I allow the applications
seeking condonation of delay in moving
the substitution application as well as
the substitution application.
 In view of the fact that
substitution application has already
been allowed, application seeking setting
aside abetment also stands disposed of
accordingly.
 Let amended memo of parties be
placed on record within a week.
 All the CLMAs stand disposed of
accordingly.
 (Alok Singh, J.)
 5.12.2014
Avneet/
